run.ground_truth: Video A uses a quinoa mixture for the final coating after flour and egg, pressing firmly to adhere the grains. Video B uses seasoned bread crumbs instead, employing tongs to ensure even coverage without pressing. While both follow flour-egg-coating sequence, Video A's quinoa creates a textured crust while Video B achieves crispiness through traditional bread crumbs.
